items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: There was a guy I knew of in Kentucky named Hurley.

ctx.x: We -- in Trent's band -- we left Little Rock and went our way north, seeking our -- you know, seeking our fortune. You know what I mean? We played Memphis, Tennessee. That's how we (unintelligible) Jimmy Lunceford. We went on and played on around through Jackson, Tennessee; on through Nashville; on up into Louisville, Kentucky.
There was a guy I knew of in Kentucky named Hurley. He was a red cap for Union Station, but he was a band promoter. He promoted all of the bands there at that time. His name was Hurley.
